title: Grateful Dead Live at Family Dog at the Great Highway on 1970-02-04
venue: Family Dog at the Great Highway

ai_review.summary: Excellent soundboard capture of a remarkable 30‑minute half‑set, featuring tight transitions and classic Dead favorites.
ai_review.review: The short but sweet performance is hailed by reviewers as one of the best half‑hours ever recorded, with a tight setlist that rolls through crowd‑pleasers like “Cold Rain And Snow,” “China Cat Sunflower → I Know You Rider” and “Good Lovin' → Uncle John’s Band.”  The .sbd source delivers clear, crisp audio despite its brevity, making the recording both enjoyable to listen to and historically interesting.

ai_rating.rationale: Three out of four reviewers gave high marks (4‑5 stars) praising the performance; one negative review was unrelated to quality. No technical complaints, so a strong rating is justified despite limited detail.

recording_quality.technical_notes: No specific issues noted; reviewers describe it as clear and enjoyable even though the recording is only about 30 minutes long.

standout_songs: China Cat Sunflower → I Know You Rider
show_quality.setlist_flow: A compact half‑hour set that weaves many classics together with seamless segues, delivering a high‑energy, tightly‑packed performance.
